text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (October 17, 2024) for 708 Kennedy Road.

The Property Standards Committee - Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (October 17, 2024) for 708 Kennedy Road, Folder Number 24 226822 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to March 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
